title: a comparison of two different physical dimensions is refused, not judged by raw magnitudes
note: FOUND 2026-09-03 by probe, FIXED the same day. `crate.mass <= crate.massLimit` with a mass in kg and a limit mistyped as a length in m was reported SATISFIED by both surfaces: the unit-aware evaluator refused it (`M and L are different physical dimensions`) but that refusal shared its reason tag with the bare-literal contract (`mtow [kg] <= 25.0`, `M and 1`), which the scalar fallback is entitled to fill — so the fallback filled this one too and compared the raw 18.5 with the raw 25. A clash of two NON-dimensionless dimensions is now its own reason (`dimension-clash`) and a refusal on every surface: the validation and numeric checks, the simulator, and the solver's relation set. The bare-literal contract is unchanged. The repair is checked by message, not only by code — this case's only diagnostic is an INFO, and an info code alone left the repair invariant vacuous.

diagnostics.message: /M and L are different physical dimensions — no conversion relates them, so the comparison cannot be judged/
